$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: it is the REAL CAPTURE of the evaluation-plan project, produced by the live eval:ci path (tea-ci-runner through the local Claude Code CLI, the harness's own prompt and staged workspace) over the skill with step-03b-render-evaluation-plans.md.

The run found evals/grader/ci/evaluation-ci-plan.json without being told where it was and the evaluations folder's package.json beside it, wrote an evaluation-pr job under the plan's marker, chose its Node version against the tooling's floor, installed evals/ with --prefix (the paths quoted for the shell, as the step says), rendered the plan's five pr checks as the one `tea-evaluate ci --tier pr` step named for all five, and uploaded evals/grader/runs/ under if: always().

storedOutput.capturedBy: a live `node test/eval-ci.js --agent claude --runs 2 --set evaluation-plan-quarry-grader` run on 2026-10-01 (10 of 10 requested elements, 0 unrequested, stable across both repetitions, every threshold met), whose staged workspace and prompt were run once more by hand through cli/ci-runner.js and the local Claude Code CLI because the harness discards the workflow it scores; the file is the by-hand run's, byte for byte

derivation: The file parses and actionlint reports nothing. All ten requested elements are present: the pull_request trigger scoped to main, contents:read, the Node version from .nvmrc in the test job, the root npm ci and npm test, an evaluation job whose Node version is chosen by a step that keeps the project's .nvmrc only at or above the tooling's 22.20.0 floor, the evaluations folder's install, the one tea-evaluate ci step run through npm exec with that prefix and named for the five checks, the evaluation-pr job under its marker, and the upload of evals/grader/runs/ under always().
Zero unrequested elements and zero rule violations: the only upload is the requested one, and neither the evaluation step nor its job carries continue-on-error.
